en.card.allowDowngrade: Allow downgrade (auto may drop to low)
en.card.allowUpgrade: Allow upgrade (auto may lift to max)
en.card.capabilities.apiUnsupported: This provider uses a non-openai-completions protocol: thinkingFormat / supportsReasoningEffort are openai-completions-only fields and are not offered here (a write carrying them is rejected wholesale by the host). The thinking switch is unaffected: it writes the protocol-neutral reasoningEfforts, which pi-ai maps natively per protocol.
en.card.capabilities.atLeastThinking: Select at least one thinking level (other than off)
en.card.capabilities.contextHint: Pick a preset or enter an integer (2000–1000000); written to llm-pi-ai for context pressure/compaction and applied to the next request without a restart.
en.card.capabilities.contextInteger: Context length must be an integer (2000-1000000)
en.card.capabilities.contextRange: Context length must be between 2000 and 1000000
en.card.capabilities.developerRoleHint: Official compat switch (dsh ≥ v0.1.0-rc.8): writes route-level compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false so the system prompt is sent as role system — fixes the Unexpected message role 400 on vLLM / SGLang gateways. Unchecking deletes the field and restores inheritance.
en.card.capabilities.efforts: Thinking effort levels (tick, then enter the wire value)
en.card.capabilities.empty: No custom provider has models configured in llm-pi-ai. Add a provider and models under Settings → Models first.
en.card.capabilities.failed: Save failed: the value was rejected or conflicted. Check it.
en.card.capabilities.hint: Reads and writes the llm-pi-ai config directly: tick a level and enter the exact value sent to the gateway (e.g. high → ultra); leaving off empty means “do not send”. Vision gates image input; the thinking toggle drives enable_thinking; thinkingFormat picks the wire serialization.
en.card.capabilities.mediaHint: Video/audio declarations are written to the taken-over transport’s extraInputs (the host model-row input enum only accepts text|image). Effective only while the route is taken over; when off, matching content blocks are refused or masked per modalFallback.
en.card.capabilities.presetGeneric: Apply to all: Off / Low / Medium / High (generic)
en.card.capabilities.presetOfficial: Apply to all: Off / High / Max (official DeepSeek style)
en.card.capabilities.search: Search models by name or ID…
en.card.capabilities.staleCompat: openai-completions-only fields an older version forced onto this model row
en.card.capabilities.takeoverHint: When checked, the model requests of this route are short-circuited through the dsh-llm-openai-completions transport (multimodal true-send, modality gate, prompt injection) and pi-ai steps out. Writes the providers list of the transport itself; unchecking removes the route. Requires the transport to be installed.
en.card.capabilities.takeoverHintAbsent: The dsh-llm-openai-completions transport is not installed — install and enable it to take routes over per route.
en.card.capabilities.thinkingNative: The thinking switch is available on every protocol: it writes the protocol-neutral reasoningEfforts, which pi-ai maps natively (Anthropic thinking budget / Responses reasoning effort). thinkingFormat / supportsReasoningEffort are openai-completions-only and appear only once the model is declared a thinking model on that protocol.
en.card.capabilities.unavailable: The llm-pi-ai settings namespace is unavailable.
en.card.defaultPricing.cn: cn — CNY calibration tier (off-catalog still falls back to the typical price)
en.card.defaultPricing.custom: custom — self-entered rates (unpriced without a full row)
en.card.defaultPricing.estimate: estimate — typical-price fallback (uncalibrated, reference only; default)
en.card.defaultPricing.global: global — USD calibration tier (off-catalog stays estimated until USD rows land)
en.card.defaultPricing.off: off — do not bill (off-catalog shows "not billed")
en.card.defaultPricingHint: How to price models the catalog does not list (including gateway models brought in by other plugins); catalogued models always use their own rates. Pricing changes only affect new accounting from now on.
en.card.description: Pick Auto in the model selector: the plugin schedules low / high / max per tool round before submitting the API effort. Here you configure the default level, scheduler bounds, and per-model capabilities (level → gateway wire value mapping).
en.card.level.off: off — disable thinking (manual only, never auto-picked)
en.card.level.on: on — enable thinking (toggle-only models only; sends enable_thinking, never an effort)
en.card.masterTakeoverHint: Master switch: its state mirrors into the transport’s enabled on every start (the sole writer). The per-route “Third-party takeover” checkboxes own membership only; with the master off, checking a route lights this switch automatically.
en.card.takeoverUiHint: On: this plugin replaces the composer model picker with its own panel (per-line context/effort editors + search). Off (default): the official popup stays — the auto level still appears, and search and loading remain the shipped selector’s. Changes apply immediately — no reload needed.
en.card.title: Thinking Levels
en.card.unavailable: Settings namespace unavailable: make sure dsh-thinking-levels is assembled into this profile.
en.family.title: Qizi Plugin Settings
en.input.context.globalHint: Applies globally to every session using this model (Clear restores the default)
en.input.context.integer: Context length must be an integer (2000-1000000)
en.input.context.range: Context length must be between 2000 and 1000000
en.input.context.title: Context window
en.input.effort.title: Reasoning effort
en.model.panel.noTarget: No writable config entry for this model
en.model.panel.unavailable: The model directory is unavailable for this session
